module signal_generator (
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    output reg [4:0] wave
);
    reg [1:0] state;
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (~rst_n) begin
            state <= 2'b00;
            wave <= 5'b0;
        end
        else begin
            case(state)
                2'b00: begin
                    if(wave == 5'b11111) begin
                        state <= 2'b01;
                    end
                    else begin
                        wave <= wave + 1;
                    end
                end
                2'b01: begin
                    if(wave == 5'b00000) begin
                        state <= 2'b00;
                    end
                    else begin
                        wave <= wave - 1;
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end
    
endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="signal_generator">
    <description>Triangle Wave Signal Generator</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <output id="wave" width_description="[4:0]">5-bit output waveform signal representing the generated waveform.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="0">Initial state for waveform generation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="1">Transition state for waveform generation.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state" width_description="[1:0]">Register to store the current state of the waveform generation process.</reg>
        <reg id="wave" width_description="[4:0]">Register to store the generated waveform signal.</reg>
        
        <always_comb>
            <case>
                <when condition="~rst_n">
                    <assign state = 0;
                           wave = 0;
                </when>
                
                <when condition="state == 0">
                    <assign wave = wave + 1;
                    
                    <if condition="wave == 31">
                        <assign state = 1;
                    </if>
                </when>
                
                <when condition="state == 1">
                    <assign wave = wave - 1;
                    
                    <if condition="wave == 0">
                        <assign state = 0;
                    </if>
                </when>
            </case>
        </always_comb>
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>Generates a triangle wave signal by incrementing and decrementing the 'wave' signal based on the current state.</implementation>
</module>
